subject: Privileged hosting: Boreal narrow-scope audit & discount request
messages:
From: Amir Sattar <amir.sattar@borealhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@borealhealth.com
Date: 2026-01-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private hosting ask + SOW (narrow audit window)

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Boreal is excited about Redwood's Dedicated offering. We're working toward a Jan pilot and I wanted to surface two items that are blockers for Procurement and Legal before we can finalize a PoC SOW:

1) Data residency: all Boreal PHI-related tokens must remain in our US-East VPC. No cross-region backups.
2) Audit / access: Legal is asking for audit rights but limited in scope — they only want a 4-hour on-site/remote audit window per 12 months (not open-ended access to host machines or keys).
3) Host access: we cannot give 3rd-party vendors full root; we propose scoped, time-boxed read-only logs and a vetted engineer session via jumpbox.
4) Pricing: because of the extra operational constraints, Procurement is requesting a one-time setup credit and a 25% first-year usage discount (committed 12 months).

I've attached the SOW draft and our security questionnaire. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate the narrow audit window + the discount request? If not, what alternative mitigations do you recommend so Legal can sign off?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — Procurement needs an answer by Friday.

Best,
Amir
VP, IT & Procurement
Boreal Health

Attachments:
- Boreal_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW vignette)
- Boreal_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (answers in progress)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Sattar <amir.sattar@borealhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private hosting ask + SOW (narrow audit window)

Amir — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Rishi (Account Exec) and Lauren (Legal Ops) so we can triage.

Short answers up front:
- Data residency in a single US-East VPC is doable for Dedicated/Private. We'll need the exact subnet details for the onboarding checklist.
- Narrow 4-hour audit window: we don't typically limit scope that tightly, but we can propose a compensated, time-boxed inspection with pre-defined artifacts (logs, orchestration events, network flows) and a technical liaison from our side rather than host-level root access.
- Host access: agreeable to gated sessions via our jumpbox and recorded session tie-downs.
- Pricing: I'll escalate the 25% first-year commitment discount to Deal Desk — need to confirm tenure and minimum commit.

Rishi / Lauren: can you advise on the discount approval path and whether Legal can accept the time-boxed audit approach (we may need a bridge clause to allow limited evidence retention for 24 months)?

Action items:
- Rishi: run numbers and indicate what discount / credit you can propose by EOD Thursday.
- Lauren: propose wording for the SOW / security addendum to reflect a narrow audit window and the technical liaison model.

Am I missing anything, Amir?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Marissa — ran initial pricing scenarios with Deal Desk. Notes below and request to escalate to Revenue Ops / Execs for sign-off: 

- Baseline: Boreal pilot = 4x A100 equiv. Reserved annual commit estimate = $480k list.
- One-time onboarding credit: we can offer up to $15k as a setup credit (covers engineer time + tunnel setup).
- Usage discount: 25% off list for year 1 eats into margin significantly; at that size we can consider a capped promotional credit structure instead (e.g., 15% discount or $60k capped credit).
- Contract carveouts: narrow audit window + jumpbox sessions are acceptable operationally, but Legal needs an explicit indemnity/assurances clause. We should avoid removing our ability to respond to subpoenas or regulatory inquiries.

I'm requesting Exec approval for either: (A) 15% year-1 discount + $15k onboarding credit, or (B) 20% year-1 discount if Boreal commits to 18 months and increases the reserved minimum by 25%.

Lauren — can you draft two short addendum snippets: one for the time-boxed audit (list of deliverables / artifacts) and one for the host-access protocol? I want these ready for Exec review.

Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Rishi / Marissa — see proposed addendum language below. I've drafted both concise options so Execs can choose quickly; I'll attach as a redline to the SOW.

1) Time-boxed audit addendum (summary):
- Boreal is entitled to a single, scheduled audit event not to exceed four (4) consecutive hours per 12-month period.
- Redwood will provide: (a) exported orchestration logs covering the audit period, (b) relevant anonymized request/response logs, (c) a technical liaison for the session.
- Redwood will not provide host root credentials, private key material, or unredacted PHI.
- Redwood reserves the right to withhold access if request materially interferes with production SLAs; in that case Redwood will provide compensatory artifacts.

2) Host-access and jumpbox protocol (summary):
- Access is limited to named Redwood engineers with MFA and recorded session logging via jumpbox.
- Access requires 72-hour notice and a mutually agreed scope.
- Session recordings and extracted logs will be delivered to Boreal under an encrypted transport and retained for 90 days unless otherwise agreed.

Pricing/Deal Desk recommendation: present option A and B to Execs: 
- Option A (lower commitment): 15% year-1 discount + $15k onboarding credit; standard 12-month term.
- Option B (preferred economics): 20% year-1 discount if Boreal signs 18-month reserved minimum (25% larger commitment).

Next step: Rishi to prepare a short Exec summary (1 slide) with GTM impact and margin delta so Sales Ops can authorize the chosen option. I can finalize addendum redline once option is selected.

Lauren Bishop
Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
